mapper.sql: SELECT c.* FROM crm_customer c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.owner_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.id WHERE u.del_flag = 0 AND u.status = '0' ${customer.params.dataScope} ORDER BY u.nick_name, u.id
